digest:
- General Motors agreed to a $220 million settlement with 36 state attorneys general and the FTC for selling driver braking and location data without proper authorization. This highlights critical regulatory risks and compliance standards for telematics data collection. [1, 3, 10]
- P&C CEOs expressed growing dissatisfaction with commercial insurance market conditions during Q3 earnings calls. This broader market friction supports disciplined underwriting and rate adequacy efforts for specialized MGAs entering last-mile delivery. [2]
